svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.32k stars in total, about 1.81k a year earlier. jactionlint 324, mr boxington 737, aube 2066, fnox 2370, hk 1308, pitchfork 713, usage 1075, +6 more 730.
